verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerting docs describe routing issues to systems/teams via notifications and configurable thresholds (docs-5, docs-33, docs-34), and separate agentic features show automated remediation actions like opening Jira/GitHub tickets (docs-41) and a marketing claim to 'move beyond assistance to automated remediation' (docs-46), but the evidence never explicitly documents a webhook notification channel type for alert policies or a documented workflow of alert→webhook→external agent. Missing for 10: explicit webhook notification channel setup for alerts, a documented end-to-end example of an alert triggering a webhook that invokes an automation/agent, and independent confirmation this works in practice.
